_doc: Template for a new chart (e.g. ColorChecker Passport Video). Copy to <chart_id>.json (no leading underscore) and fill it. 'rows'/'cols' = grid size; each patch sits at row/col (row 0 = top, as seen from the front), so gaps and irregular layouts are fine. Give each patch ONE of: "lab": [L, a, b] (CIELAB D50, as X-Rite / Calibrite publish them), "srgb": [r, g, b] (8-bit sRGB), "linear": [r, g, b] (linear Rec.709). The chart shows up in the Lookdev Rig 'Chart' list of every toolbar.
label: My chart
